title: Shesh Theke Shuru
desc: Mahid, a Dhaka-based businessman, falls in love with a girl on a flight to London. Soon enough, his relationship is threatened as his dark past resurfaces.

title: Putuler Protisodh
desc: Bini, a married woman, is murdered by her in-laws, following which her spirit possesses a doll. As she decides to seek revenge, her husband's second wife must free her spirit.

title: Maya Mamata
desc: Mamata is the daughter of a wealthy industrialist who is married to Anil. However, when her mother-in-law drives her away, she strives to find love again.

title: Deewana
desc: A newlywed Kajal gets widowed when her husband, Ravi, is killed by his enemies. She moves to another city and gets married to Raja, but her life takes a turn when Ravi returns from the dead.
